## §6 Retention — PERMANENT; the sweep never touches the register (your §5.2) — first in order
`retention_policy: forecast_ledger_1y` + `expires_at` in 2027 on all 52 rows contradicts ToS §12.3 (*"Anchored Decision Assets and their Resolution records are retained in the Record and remain independently verifiable notwithstanding termination"*) and the thesis: a record that expires is not a record. **Rulings:** (1) `mnemosyne/sweep.py:sweep_expired` gains a hard exclusion of the forecast ledger and every Decision Asset / resolution table, with a test that fails if the exclusion is removed; (2) the served fields: if `retention_policy`/`expires_at` sit **outside** the anchored bytes → set `retention_policy: permanent`, `expires_at: null` on every row (one PR); if **inside** for any anchored row → the display layer overrides with the rendering note, stored bytes untouched; report which; (3) you check the box crontab read-only for any sweep caller and report; (4) the Privacy Policy's retention provisions keep governing "other Account data" only. This is first in order — a served contradiction of the Terms on every row.
